name: oracle
description: Contract-complete oracle prompt (Section 9A.2), written from task_contract.md alone before any model output. Ceiling arm and source of every injected defect.

sections.instruction: Extract the name, event date, and venue of the single target college event described in the supplied notice.
sections.context: Each notice describes exactly one clearly named target college event. A notice may omit information, mention registration deadlines or publication dates, give an explicit correction of a previously stated value, or contain two conflicting values with no stated resolution.
sections.constraints: Use only information explicitly stated in the notice. Copy values verbatim from the notice; do not reformat dates or paraphrase. The venue is the full location phrase as stated, not a truncated part of it. Return null for any field the notice does not state. Return null when two conflicting values appear and the notice does not resolve the conflict. An explicit correction such as rescheduled from X to Y selects the corrected value Y. A registration deadline, publication date, or previous event date is not the current event date. Do not guess.
sections.output_format: Return exactly one JSON object and no other text. The object must contain exactly the keys event, date, and venue, all present. event is a nonempty string. date and venue are each either a nonempty string or JSON null. Do not add extra keys, Markdown fences, explanations, or any text outside the JSON object.
